title: NABU Project Dataset Schemas
description: Schema definition for the restricted dataset found in this repo (AS_output_restricted.json) and the unrestricted dataset (output by the data collection tool), not found in this repo as it may contain sensitive identifying information. Each dataset is a list of dictionary records.

listing_identifier.description: Unique identifier assigned to the listing (internal ID).

title.description: Title of the listing as displayed on the platform.

price.description: Listed price as a raw string (may be empty or non-standardised).

evaluation_certificate.description: Indicates whether the listing claims to include an evaluation certificate.

seller_name.description: Seller name or pseudonimised identifier, depending on dataset version.

seller_url.description: Seller profile URL or pseudonomised identifier, depending on dataset version.

seller_country.description: Country of the seller as self-reported in the listing (often in Arabic).

seller_phone_number.description: Seller phone number (partially redacted in the restricted dataset).

listing_url.description: Listing URL or pseudonimised identifier, depending on dataset version.

site_name.description: Name of the platform where the listing was posted ('اثار').

publication_date.description: Timestamp when the listing was originally published.

modification_date.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the listing.
